page.notes: Doubtful readings: "follicitus" printed without a second l, kept as printed. The initial letter of the first word and the first letter of the page are read as printed. Changed for convention: Vtraque to Utraque, Vrbe to Urbe, Vtraque in the heading, Personam to Personam, est to est, sum to sum, vsu to usu, vsque to usque, susceperit to susceperit, refistat to resistat, Honestatis to Honestatis, Virtutis, Eccentricus and fistat (long s to plain s). Italic: Nova, Scena, Honestatis, Virtutis, Eccentricus, fistat are italic as printed; the italic status of Scena is uncertain. The paragraph beginning "Nempe" continues beyond this page.
